title: Anthropic monthly spend reads $9134 / $400 cap — ALL council calls blocked at runtime
needs_human_reasons: triage-2026-05-26: confirmed STALE — surface no longer matches bug claim (Item 3 pre-bootstrap triage)

intake_metadata.summary: PR #260 introduced VENDOR_MONTHLY_CAP_DEFAULTS with anthropic=, google=, openai=, perplexity=, xai=. Live spend per getVendorMonthlySpendUsd(): anthropic=.70 (22.8x cap), google=.40 (1.9x), openai=.41 (1.6x), perplexity=.96 (4.2x), xai=.19 (OK). Source: data/polish-cost-trace-2026-05-19.json contains a .95 record for a single 20110-token Opus call (implausibly high — likely per-1k vs per-1M pricing bug). Cost tracker reads un-corrected files; corrected variants exist but regex excludes them. EVERY council fan-out path that hits anthropic/google/openai/perplexity will refuse with COUNCIL_CAP_REACHED — including bug-resolver (already observed), regression-guard auto-action, intel-refresh, network-enricher, polish-loop. xai-only paths still work. Resolution: fix the 2026-05-19 cost-trace records OR raise caps OR exclude-bad-files-from-sum.

title: GEMINI_FREE_API_KEY unset — Tier-0 Flash cascade never gets free-tier benefit

intake_metadata.summary: PR #260 wired google:gemini-2.5-flash as Tier-0 cascade for conversational_chat archetype, with GEMINI_FREE_API_KEY → free-tier (15 RPM / 1M TPM / 1500 RPD) → fall through to paid GEMINI_API_KEY on 429/403. .env + launchctl env have NO GEMINI_FREE_API_KEY set. Every conversational_chat call falls immediately through to paid endpoint — cost-relief PR #260 promised never realized for this archetype. Resolution: set GEMINI_FREE_API_KEY in .env OR document that free-tier is opt-in OR remove the cascade if free-tier isn't reliably available for this workload.
